display_goal:
Place one outbound account-servicing call to the recipient about Northbridge Lending account ending 9003 / A-9003. Open the call by saying this disclosure in full, before anything else, without skipping, shortening, or paraphrasing: "Hello, this is an automated assistant calling on behalf of Northbridge Lending about your account ending 9003. This is an attempt to collect a debt, and any information obtained will be used for that purpose. If you would like us to stop calling, say stop calling and I will end this call and remove your number."

Then say: "Our records show a balance of 42.00 USD that is past due. I am only here to arrange a payment date. Would you like to set a date to pay, or would you rather discuss this with a person?"

Handle payment logistics only by asking whether the recipient will commit to a payment date; do not collect payment details, do not give financial, legal, or credit advice, do not negotiate the balance, and do not threaten any consequence. Keep the call under three minutes.

If the recipient says anything that means stop calling, do not call again, take me off your list, or opt me out, immediately acknowledge exactly: "Understood. I will remove your number and you will not receive further calls from us. Goodbye." Then end the call; do not attempt to keep them on the line, do not ask why, and do not offer alternatives.

If the recipient disputes the debt, acknowledge the dispute, state that it will be recorded, and end the call.

Success outcome: report exactly one of these outcomes: promise_to_pay, dispute, refusal, no_answer, opt_out. If the outcome is promise_to_pay, also report the date the recipient committed to in YYYY-MM-DD format. Failure/no-answer outcome: if nobody answers, report no_answer; if the recipient refuses without opting out or disputing, report refusal.

next_step.instruction: Report the final outcome as opt_out and do not place another call for this request.
